summary: Omnitek Engineering filed an 8-K reporting a change of control under Item 5.01 after issuing 5,000 shares of Series A Preferred Stock to Hard Rock Holdco, LLC for $500,000 on September 29, 2026, each carrying 50,000 votes (250,000,000 votes total). A second $500,000 tranche is due within 90 days. The company separately issued a five-year warrant for 91,666,666 common shares at $0.004, raising $550,000, with a 4.99% beneficial ownership blocker. The vote-weighted preferred lets the holder control board elections, so watch board reconstitution, dilution, and the Tranche 2 overhang.
